description: This file defines commands and related functionalities for the Notesnook application's command palette, including command registration, recent command management, and context-specific command generation.

classes.name: BaseCommand
classes.description: Interface representing a basic command with an ID and type.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Extended command interface including title, group, icon, action, and recents exclusion flag.

classes.name: RecentCommand
classes.description: Interface for commands stored as recent, with a fixed group 'recent'.

methods.name: getDefaultCommands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of default commands including recents, active notes, notebooks, tags, editor commands, and static commands.

methods.name: getCommandById
methods.description: Finds and returns a command by its ID from static and editor commands.

methods.name: resolveRecentCommand
methods.description: Resolves a recent command to a full command object with title and icon.

methods.name: getRecentCommands
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recent commands from configuration storage.

methods.name: addRecentCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to the recent commands list, avoiding duplicates and respecting exclusion flags.

methods.name: removeRecentCommand
methods.description: Removes a command from the recent commands list by ID.

methods.name: getActiveNoteCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the currently active note, including menu actions.

methods.name: getActiveNotebookCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the current notebook context.

methods.name: getActiveTagCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the current tag context.

methods.name: getEditorCommands
methods.description: Provides commands for editor tabs and undo/redo actions.

methods.name: menuItemToCommands
methods.description: Converts a menu item into one or more command objects.

methods.name: getCommandTitle
methods.description: Fetches the display title for a recent command based on its ID and type.
